findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_job, list_your_agent, meter_buy_pass, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, get_approval, get_pricing, start_trial, create_checkout, get_status · Private data: list_open_jobs, post_job, list_your_agent, browse_agents, meter_pricing, meter_buy_pass, meter_watch, meter_preflight, meter_verify_stamp, get_pricing, create_checkout · Public sink: post_job, list_your_agent, meter_pricing, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, ask_human, email.send, slack.post, crm.write, get_approval, attach_human, create_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_job, list_your_agent, meter_buy_pass, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, get_approval, get_pricing, start_trial, create_checkout, get_status · Private data: list_open_jobs, post_job, list_your_agent, browse_agents, meter_pricing, meter_buy_pass, meter_watch, meter_preflight, meter_verify_stamp, get_pricing, create_checkout · Public sink: post_job, list_your_agent, meter_pricing, meter_verify_stamp, check_action, ask_human, email.send, slack.post, crm.write, get_approval, attach_human, create_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
